answer: Each identity binds one organ-donor record in the Dawn Registry, whose donor hash goes on-chain; it locks a 30 POA bond for 90 days, doubling per extra record from one cluster (30/60/120/240, capped at 960 POA). Forging 100 fakes needs 100 donors and 92,130 POA locked, so each new fake costs more than the last. Each epoch a ripple check re-confirms status within 72 hours; two missed checks halve the bond and halt payouts for 3 epochs. A tide audit re-checks 5% of records quarterly, and duplicate records slash both bonds. Opted-out donors pass with a doctor-signed waiver plus a doubled bond.
